title: Get alerts on your phone
summary: A notification for every new booking, deposit and lead, plus an 8pm money check and your week on Sunday.

steps.title: Turn on alerts
steps.body: Go to Settings, then Account, and tap "Turn on alerts". Allow notifications when your phone asks. Each phone or tablet you sign in on is switched on separately.

steps.title: On an iPhone
steps.body: Add Tikka to your home screen first: in Safari, tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen". Open Tikka from that icon and turn alerts on there. It needs iOS 16.4 or newer.

steps.title: What you'll get
steps.body: A notification when someone books or pays a deposit, when a pay link is paid, and when someone claims a drop. At 8pm: anything you spent today? On Sunday evening: what came in, what you spent and what you kept.

tips: Tap "Send it now" to see a test notification on this phone straight away.
